name: heatmap
title: Heatmap
description: Contribution-style grid for daily activity. Cells pop in column by column.
htmlExample:
<bef-heatmap id="hm" class="w-full max-w-3xl"></bef-heatmap>
<script>document.getElementById('hm').props = { values: Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, i) => (i * 7 + (i % 5) * 3) % 9) };</script>
